name: Ontology CLI And Docs Boundary Split
description: Split the oversized ontology CLI implementation and ontology documentation along matching operational boundaries while preserving public command behavior, JSON output shapes, activation lifecycle semantics, and evidence behavior.

userStories.title: Inventory Current Ontology CLI And Documentation Boundaries
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the current ontology CLI functions and ontology document families mapped before splitting so that the refactor follows the existing system shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce an inventory section in this PRD or a companion note listing major `packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.ts` function groups.

Inventory includes activation, artifact registry, prompt extraction, prompt artifact extraction, quality-status evidence, quality-ledger evidence, ingest/status, and route/corridor/checkpoint/junction/diff surfaces.
Inventory lists current oversized ontology docs and their proposed target families.
Confirm no public command path should change in this PRD.
Confirm no activation lifecycle, rollback, REST, remote activation, scoped prefix, or pack authoring behavior is added.
Record the target module file names before implementation begins.
userStories.notes: US-001 inventory recorded in tasks/prd-ontology-cli-docs-boundary-split.md under `US-001 Current Inventory`. It freezes current ontology CLI function groups, target module filenames, oversized doc target families, command paths, and non-goal behavior before extraction stories begin. Required US-001 gates passed.

userStories.title: Promote Registry Allocation Documentation To Module And Leaf Structure
userStories.description: As a documentation maintainer, I want the registry allocation document family split into module and leaf specs so lifecycle, activation, evidence, and scenario concerns have stable coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: Convert `operational-ontology-registry-allocation` into a module-level overview if it owns multiple leaf concerns.
Add or update contains links for lifecycle, activation CLI, activation result, activation evidence, and activation scenario matrix leaf docs.
Create or update `operational-ontology-registry-lifecycle.spec.md` for Phase 2A through Phase 5 lifecycle current state.
Create or update `operational-ontology-registry-activation-result.spec.md` for activation result payload, no-rollback policy, and structured failure semantics.
Create or update `operational-ontology-registry-activation-evidence.spec.md` for `--output`, `--artifact-registry`, `activation-evidence`, registry append/upsert, and provider consumption behavior.
Keep `operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli.spec.md` focused on command surface and local runtime boundary.
Keep `operational-ontology-registry-activation-cli-scenario-matrix.spec.md` focused on scenario proof and evidence references.
Update sources and links so `qa-sdk docs status operational-ontology-registry-allocation` shows the intended family without unrelated PRDs.
userStories.notes: Promoted operational-ontology-registry-allocation to a module overview and moved lifecycle, activation result, and activation evidence concerns into dedicated leaf specs. Updated contains/back-links so docs status for the registry allocation family includes lifecycle, activation CLI, activation result, activation evidence, and scenario matrix leaves without task PRD sources. Required US-002 gates passed.

userStories.title: Split Programming Artifact Ontology Documentation By Provider And Evidence Concerns
userStories.description: As a programming artifact ontology maintainer, I want CLI, provider, activation evidence, and quality-status evidence concerns split so future artifact work has precise document coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep `programming-artifact-ontology-system` as a module or concise system overview.
Create or update `programming-artifact-ontology-registry-provider.spec.md` for `ArtifactRegistryPromptArtifactContextProvider` and generic registry lookup behavior.
Create or update `programming-artifact-ontology-activation-evidence.spec.md` for activation evidence artifact kind and provider consumption.
Create or update `programming-artifact-ontology-quality-evidence.spec.md` for quality-status, quality ledger fallback, freshness SLA, and governance closure behavior.
Keep `programming-artifact-ontology-cli.spec.md` focused on CLI command contracts and flag behavior.
Update contains/depends_on/refines links so top-down docs traversal can assemble the programming artifact ontology module without mixing implementation details into the overview.
Update source references to the split CLI modules created later in this PRD when applicable.
userStories.notes: Split programming-artifact ontology docs into a concise module overview plus registry provider, activation evidence, and quality evidence leaves. Kept CLI doc focused on public command/flag/JSON contracts, linked provider/evidence leaves with contains/back-links, kept current monolith source references until later extraction stories create split CLI modules, and passed all required US-003 gates.

userStories.title: Establish Source Reference And Docs Control-Plane Checks For Split Boundaries
userStories.description: As a docs control-plane user, I want split docs to have source references and status checks so bottom-up code-to-doc lookup becomes practical.
acceptanceCriteria: Add source references for the new or updated ontology docs to the future split module paths where possible.
Keep source references conservative when a module has not yet been extracted.
Run `qa-sdk docs status` on the registry allocation family and programming artifact ontology family and record whether family scope is narrow enough.
Run `qa-sdk docs collect` for at least one new leaf doc and ensure unrelated PRD families do not dominate the result.
Do not add source comments or `@def.doc` annotations in this story unless needed for a concrete missing bottom-up lookup.
Record any source-map coverage gaps as follow-up TODOs instead of widening current scope.
userStories.notes: Recorded conservative future source boundaries in the registry allocation and programming artifact ontology leaf docs while keeping frontmatter sources on existing files until split modules exist. docs status reported narrow scopes for operational-ontology-registry-allocation (13 related, 0 tasks/diagnostics) and programming-artifact-ontology-system (12 related, 0 tasks/diagnostics). docs collect for operational-ontology-registry-activation-evidence returned 3 related docs, 18 sources, 0 tasks/diagnostics, with no unrelated PRD family dominance. Source-map gaps were recorded as TODOs and no source comments or @def.doc annotations were added. Required US-004 gates passed.

acceptanceCriteria: Move registry activation value/boolean flag definitions, parser, prefix override parsing, address model parsing, activation CLI failure result construction, output sidecar writing, text summary printing, known pack import refs, and `cmdRegistryActivatePack` into a dedicated module such as `packages/cli/src/commands/ontology/activation.ts`.

Keep `--output` sidecar raw helper payload behavior unchanged.
Leave `packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.ts` as the router/import owner for this command.
Update tests only for import paths if required; do not rename existing activation scenario test titles.

userStories.title: Verify Behavior Preservation And File Size Reduction
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want proof that the split preserved behavior and made the code/docs easier to operate.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.ts` is reduced to a thin router or at least below 1,500 lines after extraction.
No extracted module exceeds 1,500 lines unless the story documents why it remains a follow-up.
Existing ontology CLI tests pass without public command behavior changes.
Activation CLI scenario matrix still references valid test titles after the split.
`qa-sdk docs status packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.ts` or the closest supported bottom-up query reports a clear limitation or source mapping path instead of returning the full repository.
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js docs drift --prd tasks/prd-ontology-cli-docs-boundary-split.json --json` reports zero issues after this PRD is complete.
Record residual refactor debt in the appropriate TODO, not in implementation comments.
